idiom.title: Cup of Joe
idiom.interpretationEn: The exact origin of this phrase is uncertain, but the most common explanation is that it is linked to Josephus “Joe” Daniels, the Secretary of the Navy, who prohibited alcohol on Navy ships in 1914, leading sailors to drink more coffee instead. Another simpler explanation is that “Joe” is a slang term for “man” or “fellow,” and coffee is a common beverage, making it “a cup of Joe.”
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语的具体起源尚无定论，但最常见的一种解释是它来源于美国海军部长约瑟夫斯·丹尼尔斯（Josephus “Joe” Daniels），他在 1914 年禁止海军舰船上供应酒类，这样水手们就转向喝咖啡了。另一种解释更为简单：“Joe” 是 “man” 或 “fellow” 的非正式称呼，而咖啡是普通大众每日必饮之物，所以就成为了 “a cup of Joe”。

examples.en: I need a cup of Joe to start my day.
examples.zh: 我需要一杯咖啡来开始我的一天。

examples.en: Let’s grab a cup of Joe and catch up.
examples.zh: 我们去喝杯咖啡，聊聊近况吧。

examples.en: A cup of Joe always helps me wake up in the morning.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡总是能让我在早晨醒过来。

people.name: Saul Kripke
people.extract: Saul Aaron Kripke was an American philosopher and logician. He was a distinguished professor of philosophy at the Graduate Center of the City University of New York and a professor emeritus at Princeton University. From the 1960s until his death, he was a central figure in a number of fields related to mathematical and modal logic, philosophy of language and mathematics, metaphysics, epistemology, and recursion theory.
highlights: Professor at CUNY and Princeton University.
Central figure in mathematical and modal logic.

people.name: Joseph F. Smith
people.bio: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
people.extract: Joseph Fielding Smith Sr. was an American religious leader who served as the sixth president of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He was a nephew of Joseph Smith, founder of the Latter Day Saint movement, and the last LDS Church president who had personally known him.
highlights: Sixth president of the LDS Church.
Nephew of Joseph Smith, movement founder.
Last LDS president who knew Joseph Smith.

people.name: Juhi Chawla
people.extract: Juhi Chawla Mehta is an Indian actress. She established herself as one of the leading actresses of Hindi cinema from the late 1980s through the early 2000s. Recognised for her comic timing and vivacious on-screen persona, she is the recipient of several accolades, including two Filmfare Awards. As of 2025, she is the wealthiest Indian actress, with a net worth of ₹7,790 crore (US$830 million).
highlights: Leading Indian actress in Hindi cinema.
